title: 27-Year-Old Missouri Man Admits Role in Failed Bitcoin Kidnapping Plot
summary: Bitcoin Magazine 27-Year-Old Missouri Man Admits Role in Failed Bitcoin Kidnapping Plot A St. Louis man pleaded guilty in Hartford to conspiracy to commit Hobbs Act robbery over a failed August 2024 plot to steal bitcoin from a Connecticut family. This post 27-Year-Old Missouri Man Admits Role in Failed Bitcoin Kidnapping Plot first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
